items.docs: Generate track recommendations from one or more seeds (track, artist, or album IDs). The engine clusters songs, artists, and audio features and returns tracks whose characteristics best match the seeds. Optional audio-feature target parameters can be supplied to steer the results toward a desired sound and mood.
